name: Encantado
description: A shapeshifting being of Amazonian Brazilian folklore that lives by day as a pink river dolphin (boto cor-de-rosa) and emerges at night, especially during festivals, in the form of a tall, handsome, white-clad man who seduces women and lures the unwary into the underwater realm of Encante.

aliases.name: Boto cor-de-rosa
aliases.meaning: 'Pink boto'; the Amazon river dolphin in its mythical aspect

aliases.name: Boto
aliases.meaning: Common name for Inia geoffrensis, the Amazon river dolphin

origin: Concentrated in the Brazilian Amazon basin (states of Amazonas, Pará, Acre, Rondônia, Roraima, Amapá), with parallel traditions in adjacent Amazonian regions of Peru, Colombia, Bolivia, Venezuela, and the Guianas.
